title: Promotional New Money Offer Terms for Money Market Tiers
content:
The promotional annual percentage yield of Savings & Money Market Accounts is a per-tier parameter that replaces the base annual percentage yield on the promotional portion of the balance during the promotional period. Five parameters state the offer: the promotional yield itself, the number of calendar months from the opening date during which it applies, the new money that must be deposited for it to apply, the largest daily balance it is paid on, and the calendar days after the opening date within which new money counts toward that minimum.

| Tier | Promotional annual percentage yield | Duration from the opening date | Minimum new money | Promotional balance cap | Funding window after the opening date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | 30 calendar days |
| Statement Savings | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | 30 calendar days |
| Goal Builder Savings | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | 30 calendar days |
| Money Market Account | 3.50 percent | 6 calendar months | 25000.00 USD | 250000.00 USD | 30 calendar days |
| Premier Money Market | 3.90 percent | 6 calendar months | 25000.00 USD | 500000.00 USD | 30 calendar days |
| Private Client Money Market | 4.10 percent | 12 calendar months | 100000.00 USD | 2000000.00 USD | 30 calendar days |

### Notes on the parameters

The three savings tiers carry the value not offered for the promotional yield, its duration, its minimum new money and its balance cap. The funding window parameter is nevertheless stated as 30 calendar days on every tier of the product.

Among the three money market tiers the promotional yield rises from 3.50 percent to 4.10 percent, while the minimum new money rises from 25000.00 USD on Money Market Account and Premier Money Market to 100000.00 USD on Private Client Money Market. Only Private Client Money Market carries a duration of 12 calendar months; the other two carry 6.

The promotional balance cap is the largest daily balance the promotional yield is paid on, and it differs from the minimum new money: on a hypothetical Premier Money Market account the customer must bring 25000.00 USD of new money for the offer to apply at all, while the yield is paid on daily balance up to 500000.00 USD.
